OCCLUSAL PLANE GUIDE. DENTAL 


( Reaffirmed 1998 ) 
(Reaffirmed 2013) 


1 . Scope — Dimensions arid other requirements for occlusal plane guide used in dentistry.

4. Workmanship and Finish 




4.1 The instrument shall be absolutely flat and shall remain so during the normal use. The edges shall 
be suitably radiused. 

4.2 The instrument shall be free from surface defects and shall have mat finish. 

5. Marking — The plane guide shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark; and the country of manufacture. 

5.1 ISt Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

6. Packing — The plane guide shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bag.
